customer_request: Plan a short deployment to configure a generated logistics-tracking workflow.
stated_outcome: Improve shipment visibility while keeping field workers safe and connected to the home team.
facts: The site is fictional and the exercise involves no travel.
The scenario includes time-zone pressure, unreliable communications and shared facilities.
The employer is responsible for safe staffing, travel support and escalation arrangements.
visible_tensions: A facilitator may ask for continuous availability across two time zones.
A local contact treats harassment and transport concerns as personal resilience issues.
known_boundaries: Individual resilience never replaces organisational duty of care.
The learner must identify practical check-in, backup-contact and stop-work conditions.
learner_note: This is the learner-visible baseline. An assessor may add a controlled changed constraint during an observed exercise.
